# IFleetCommanderConfigProvider
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IFleetCommanderConfigProvider.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IFleetCommanderConfigProviderErrors](../errors/i-fleet-commander-config-provider-errors.md), [IFleetCommanderConfigProviderEvents](../events/i-fleet-commander-config-provider-events.md)

**Title:**
IFleetCommander Interface

Interface for the FleetCommander contract, which manages asset allocation across multiple Arks


## Functions
### arks

Retrieves the ark address at the specified index


```solidity
function arks(uint256 index) external view returns (address);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`index`|`uint256`|The index of the ark in the arks array|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the ark at the specified index|


### getActiveArks

Retrieves the arks currently linked to fleet (excluding the buffer ark)


```solidity
function getActiveArks() external view returns (address[] memory);
```

### getConfig

Retrieves the current fleet config


```solidity
function getConfig() external view returns (FleetConfig memory);
```

### bufferArk

Retrieves the buffer ark address


```solidity
function bufferArk() external view returns (address);
```

### isArkActiveOrBufferArk

Checks if the ark is part of the fleet or is the buffer ark


```solidity
function isArkActiveOrBufferArk(address ark) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`ark`|`address`|The address of the Ark|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool Returns true if the ark is active or the buffer ark, false otherwise.|
